review: one assistant reviewer, paired labels blinded to learning-rate/run/checkpoint identity until scores are frozen; not independent human review

character_consistency.2: Characters, identities and relationships stay consistent and relevant.
character_consistency.1: Ambiguous references, unsupported character drift, or insufficient continuation to establish consistency.
character_consistency.0: Explicit identity/relationship contradiction or dominant unexplained character replacement.

object_state_continuity.2: Prompt facts and subsequent object/location/state changes remain consistent, with plausible transitions.
object_state_continuity.1: An anchor is dropped or transitions are unclear without a definite contradiction.
object_state_continuity.0: Explicit contradiction or impossible unexplained change in an established object/state.

causal_resolution.2: The episode or introduced problem reaches a coherent resolution supported by preceding events.
causal_resolution.1: A plausible but shallow or weakly connected ending; partial resolution.
causal_resolution.0: EOS ending is incoherent, abandons an unresolved central problem, or contradicts its causal setup.
causal_resolution.null: Token-limit truncation or failed generation; do not mislabel a censored ending as failed resolution.

repetition.2: No disruptive repetition beyond ordinary narrative references.
repetition.1: Isolated redundant sentence/phrase or unnecessary restatement, but story advances.
repetition.0: Repeated clauses/sentences form a loop or dominate the continuation.

termination: Use public generate_with_token_ids with no stop sequences. Fewer than 256 returned completion IDs means EOS; exactly 256 means token limit. Record failures separately. Decoded text re-tokenization is not used to infer termination.
pairing: Each prompt and generation mode is one pair. A/B assignment is randomized independently before candidate training and withheld from scoring. Preserve every output, including errors and repetitions.
aggregation: Report each criterion distribution and paired differences where both scores are available; report EOS, token-limit and generation-error counts separately. Do not replace missing/censored scores with zero, hide failures, or claim statistical/general quality significance from this small one-seed panel.
